_ghi_chu: Chep tep nay thanh cap-nhat.json (khong dau '.example') roi sua theo may. May chua co tep nay van chay voi mac dinh ben duoi.
cap-nhat.json KHONG len kho (.gitignore) - moi may tu cau hinh rieng.
He cap nhat DUY NHAT: core/cap_nhat_git.py (git fetch + ff-only tu kho chung). Xem docs/PHAT-TRIEN-NHIEU-VPS.md.
kho: 'owner/repo' kho chung tren GitHub. Mac dinh 'manhthang1905-hub/mytool-vps'.

tu_dong_cap_nhat: true (MAC DINH, ke ca VPS moi) = co ban moi thi tu cai luc may ranh (khung :15-:45, khong dang/dung/phu de/quet), roi tu mo lai; loi lap thi tu lui. false = chi bao 'co ban moi', bam 'Cap nhat ngay' trong Cai dat. Doi ngay trong Cai dat > Cap nhat tool.
kiem_moi_phut: bao lau kiem mot lan (git fetch), mac dinh 30.
dong_bo_git.ma_may: ten ngan cua may (vd 'vps-jp1') - ghi vao CHANGELOG khi day, va ten tep chia-se/bai-hoc/<ma_may>-<ngach>.json.
dong_bo_git.cho_toi_da_phut / theo_doi_phut / khoi_dong_lai / xuat_bai_hoc: tinh chinh cua 'keo'/'day' (it khi can doi).
